research_question: Do source-linked implementation obligations improve localization of discrepancy-bearing scientific-code files over strong generic retrieval under an equal selected-code token budget?
hypothesis: Obligation-guided retrieval improves paper-level changed-file recall by at least 0.10 over the strongest non-oracle baseline.

corpus.split_rule: hash order fixed by access-preflight-contract.v2.json, followed only by component-safe reserve substitution
corpus.mutation_policy: apply synthetic changed_code_files in source row order with last-write-wins, matching the official aggregation behavior; record conflicts without excluding them
corpus.notebook_policy: convert code cells to text in source order and discard outputs
corpus.near_duplicate_gate: cluster repository snapshots by exact normalized content hash and token-set similarity before split sealing; connected components cannot cross splits

blindness.primary_gold: deduplicated union of changed_code_files.file_name for each paper
blindness.gold_isolation: materializer emits a blind corpus and a separate sealed evaluator manifest; retrieval commands accept only the blind corpus path
blindness.confirmatory_rule: confirmatory gold is not opened by method-development or retrieval processes before predictions and provenance are hashed

context_budget.packing: greedy descending score with deterministic path and start-token tie breaks; headers count toward the budget

systems.description: pack chunks by normalized file path and source order
BM25 chunks using the full extracted paper as the query
BM25 chunks using only automatically detected Methods and Experimental Setup sections
reciprocal-rank fusion of Methods BM25, path token overlap, and symbol/API overlap
one frontier-model call over paper text and a gold-free repository map, followed by deterministic chunk packing
rule-selected implementation sentences decomposed into source-linked obligations, followed by hybrid chunk retrieval
one frontier-model call extracts at most twelve source-linked implementation obligations from paper text, followed by hybrid chunk retrieval

frontier_model_fairness.paper_grade_rule: Codex CLI or codex_mock outputs may test the harness but cannot enter confirmatory evidence

primary_contrast: frontier_obligations minus the best confirmatory non-oracle baseline selected by development macro changed-file recall
failure_conditions: fewer than 8 development and 72 component-safe confirmatory units after materialization
confirmatory gold is accessed before prediction sealing
frontier model calls lack real-provider provenance
proposed retrieval fails the development promotion rule
selected-code budgets differ across compared systems

claim_ceiling.retrieval_only: retrieval-focused workshop analysis on synthetic discrepancies
claim_ceiling.retrieval_and_downstream: paper-code review assistance under the tested synthetic setting
